{{Hatnote|This page is printed Decipher cards plus original Virtual Sets 1–3 (2002 PDF slips). It is not [[Premiere to Virtual Set 3]] (2025 current-virtual retro) and not the GEMP environment named Premiere - Virtual Set 3.}}
'''Premiere - Original VS3''' is the constructed pool of printed Decipher cards through [[Theed Palace]] plus original [[Players Committee]] Virtual Sets 1–3. [[Virtual Set 3 (Original)|Virtual Set 3]] became tournament-legal on 20 September 2002.<ref name="vs2002">[[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]</ref> The short name '''POVS3''' redirects here.

The [[2002 World Championship]] (DecipherCon, 1–3 November 2002) was played in this pool. Published DeckTech 60s from that event dest original-era slips such as [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1)]], [[Molator (V) (Virtual Set 2)]], and [[Hyperwave Scan (V) (Virtual Set 3)]].
